label: Select
description: Creates a select field from simple value|Label lines.

properties.name: validation_rules
properties.label: Additional validation rules
properties.help: Comma-separated ThunderPHP rules, for example min:3,max:100. Required and field-type rules are inferred.

properties.name: show_inline_error
properties.label: Show inline error
properties.help: Displays validation errors next to this field when the configured error value is not empty.

properties.name: error_path
properties.label: Error variable path
properties.help: Leave empty to use errors.<input name>, for example errors.email.

properties.name: error_display
properties.label: Errors to display
properties.help: Show only the first message or every message stored for this field.

properties.name: error_css_class
properties.label: Error CSS classes
properties.help: Additional classes added to each inline error message.

properties.name: error_style
properties.label: Error inline styles
properties.help: CSS declarations applied directly to each inline error message, for example margin-top:.5rem; font-weight:700;

properties.name: css_class
properties.label: Wrapper CSS classes
properties.help: Added to the responsive .thv-field wrapper. Use this for selectors such as .my-field input.

properties.name: wrapper_style
properties.label: Wrapper inline styles
properties.help: CSS declarations applied directly to the responsive field wrapper.

properties.name: control_css_class
properties.label: Control CSS classes
properties.help: Added only to the input, textarea, select, or checkbox element.

properties.name: control_style
properties.label: Control inline styles
properties.help: CSS declarations applied directly to the input, textarea, select, or checkbox element.

properties.name: widths
properties.label: Responsive width
properties.help: Choose how many of 12 columns this item occupies at each breakpoint.
